runs.formHint: One run is created per month, covering the employees under an active contract in it.
runs.emptyHint: Create the month's run to compute the employees' pay and approve it.

actions.approveHint: After approval the inputs and amounts are locked and cannot be changed.
actions.cancelHint: The run is deleted with all its payslips and inputs. You can create it again later.
actions.postHint: The payroll entry is created in accounting and the run can no longer be changed. Review the proposed entry below.
actions.paymentHint: The net pay is recorded as paid from the chosen journal on the given date.

warnings.title: Warnings to review
warnings.compensation_missing: {name}: no compensation recorded, so they are left out of the computation.
warnings.missing_iban: {name}: no IBAN recorded, so they will not appear in the bank transfer file.
warnings.unmapped_department: {name}: their department has no cost center, so the cost goes to the default cost center or none.

register.title: Payroll register
register.hint: The month's inputs and every employee's figures. Inputs can be edited before approval.
register.emptyDraftHint: Compute the payroll to see each employee's payslip.

mine.title: My payslips
mine.emptyHint: Your payslip appears here once the company approves the month's run.

payslip.title: Payslip
payslip.gosiEmployerNote: Employer GOSI share: {amount}, not deducted from the pay.

settings.title: Payroll settings
settings.saveError: The settings could not be saved
settings.generalHint: These settings control how a month's pay is computed and how leave affects it.
settings.dayDivisorHint: The number of days the monthly wage is divided by to get a day's pay.
settings.structureHint: The Saudi salary structure approved for the company.
settings.unpaidLeaveTypesHint: Days of these leaves are deducted from the month's pay.
settings.annualLeaveTypeHint: Required to compute leave encashment at end of service.

gosi.title: GOSI contribution rates
gosi.hint: Contribution rates by branch, nationality class and start date. Shared rates are read-only.
gosi.deleteHint: This rate will no longer be used in computations once deleted.
gosi.emptyHint: Add the contribution rates so the system can compute GOSI.
gosi.saveError: The rate could not be saved
gosi.fieldInvalid: Enter a valid value, zero or more.

files.title: Salary files
files.hint: The bank transfer file and the WPS file, laid out by the chosen profile. Both are available once the run is approved.
files.noProfiles: No file profiles. Add them in the payroll settings.

bankProfiles.title: Bank and WPS file profiles
bankProfiles.hint: The column layout, delimiter and encoding of each file. Shared profiles are read-only.
bankProfiles.deleteHint: This profile will no longer be offered when downloading salary files.
bankProfiles.emptyHint: Add a profile to download the bank transfer file or the WPS file.
bankProfiles.saveError: The profile could not be saved
bankProfiles.columnsHint: The order of the columns is their order in the file. A constant column carries one value for every row.

errors.duplicate: A run already exists for this month.
errors.negative_net: The net pay is negative for {count} employees ({names}). Adjust the deductions and compute again.
errors.transition_forbidden: This action is not possible in the run's current state.
errors.structure_missing: The salary structure is not set in the settings.
errors.contract_missing: An employee has no active contract in this month.
errors.gosi_rate_missing: No GOSI rate applies to this month. Add one in the payroll settings.
errors.payroll_structure_mismatch: The salary structure does not match the one in the settings.
errors.notEditable: Inputs cannot be edited once the run is approved.
errors.compensation_missing: An employee has no compensation recorded. Record it and compute again.
errors.settlement_missing: An employee who left has no approved end-of-service settlement. Complete it before approving the run.
errors.period_locked: The accounting period of this action is locked.
errors.missing_cost_center: One or more departments have no cost center. Set them in the payroll settings.
errors.settings_incomplete: The payroll accounting settings are incomplete. Complete the journal and accounts in the payroll settings.
errors.missing_iban: {count} employee(s) have no IBAN ({names}). Record it in the compensation and download again.
errors.wps_totals_mismatch: The WPS file totals do not match the run totals. Review the run before downloading.

compensation.title: Compensation
compensation.emptyHint: Record the wage and allowances so payroll can use them.
compensation.forbidden: You do not have access to compensation.
compensation.wageHint: Monthly amounts in Saudi riyals. The fixed wage is the sum and is computed by the server.
compensation.bankHint: The IBAN is stored without spaces, in capital letters.
compensation.ibanInvalid: Enter a Saudi IBAN: SA followed by 22 digits.
compensation.bankKept: The bank on record is kept as it is.
compensation.basicWageInvalid: The basic wage must be greater than zero.
compensation.amountInvalid: Enter an amount of zero or more.
compensation.formHint: Only people with payroll access see these amounts.

payment.journalPlaceholder: Choose a bank or cash journal
payment.noJournals: You cannot read journals, so a payment journal cannot be chosen.
payment.periodLocked: The accounting period of the payment date is locked. Choose a date in an open period.

financeSettings.title: Payroll accounting
financeSettings.hint: The journal and accounts the payroll entry is posted to.
financeSettings.saveError: The accounting settings could not be saved
financeSettings.per_employee: Per employee: one line per employee
financeSettings.defaultAnalyticHint: Used for employees whose department has no cost center.
financeSettings.truncated: The list is shortened: only the first 200 records are shown, plus the values currently set.

costCenters.title: Department cost centers
costCenters.hint: The cost center each department's payroll cost is charged to.
costCenters.saveError: The cost center could not be saved
costCenters.truncated: The list is shortened: only the first 200 cost centers are shown, plus each department's current one.
